verified_facts: The [patch] manifest section overrides dependencies with other copies using dependency-like entries.
A patch entry may point to a path or git source.
Patch settings are taken from the workspace-root manifest, so the top-level consumer controls the patch.
Patch application is transitive across the dependency graph.
A patched crate version that already exists in the original source can replace that original crate version.
slice.narrow_inference: Consumer-controlled [patch] is a valid source-selection mechanism for substituting an alternate copy of a dependency. Conditional on an alternate no-links package copy already having a valid own manifest with build=false, [patch] can select that alternate copy instead of the original source copy. This invocation does not independently re-verify build=false semantics or compatibility after build-script suppression.
slice.verified_scope: Official Cargo Book Overriding Dependencies/[patch] behavior only; generic dependency substitution via path/git; no Cargo execution.
